_comment: ONE composite index, for the gallery listing. galQuery in src/cloud-profile.js asks for
`where pub == true` + `orderBy updated DESC` + `limit`, and Firestore will not serve a
range/order on one field alongside an equality on another without a composite index: it
answers 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION with a one-click console URL.
galList survives that — it retries unordered and sorts client-side — so the gallery has
always WORKED without this file. What it costs is a failed request on every gallery open
that misses the cache, plus a console error, and the fallback only sorts the arbitrary
`limit` documents it happened to get back: past galleryLimit scenes, 'newest' stops being
newest. This index makes the first query succeed and the ordering true beyond the page.
(`__name__` is appended implicitly, so it is not listed here.)
